---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new capability or polish for the harness
title: '[Feature] '
labels: enhancement
---

## What

One sentence on the capability.

## Why

What problem does it solve? Who benefits? Avoid theoretical use cases — point at a real friction.

## Sketch

A rough sketch of how it'd work. CLI shape, config shape, install-flow placement, etc.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you weigh, and why is this one better?
